enums.name: PropertyType
enums.doc: An enumeration for different data types in input and output models

values.name: AnyProp
values.doc: An undefined property type. Used when the type is not known or doesn't match any other type.

values.name: DecimalProp
values.doc: A property type for decimal numbers: Double and Float.

values.name: BooleanProp
values.doc: A boolean property type. Transmitted in JSON as `true` or `false`.

values.name: InstantProp
values.doc: A timestamp property type. Transmitted in JSON as ISO 8601 strings.

values.name: DurationProp
values.doc: A property for representing durations. Transmitted in JSON by coupling amount and unit, e.g. "48 seconds" or "2min"

values.name: ModelProp
values.doc: A JSON object type. Usually coupled with a model type reference.

enums.name: TokenUseType
enums.doc: An enumeration for different token use types

values.name: Bearer
values.doc: Represents a case where the token is used for bearer authentication

values.name: Basic
values.doc: Represents the basic authentication use-case, which combines username and password.
